Definition: something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves)
BiblicalUsage: 1) heap, spring, wave, billow; 1a) heap (of stones); 1a1) over dead body; 1a2) alone; 1a3) used in ratifying a covenant; 1b) waves (fig. of chastisement of Jehovah); 1c) spring
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
